style.a: Idempotency means that sending the same request multiple times produces the same final result as sending it once, without accumulating side effects. GET, PUT, and DELETE are idempotent by design, while POST is not because each invocation can create a new record. Idempotency protects against retries and network failures, but it does not automatically protect against business invariants, so the application must still enforce them.

A secret committed to a repository is exposed in every clone, every branch, and every commit history, and once leaked it can be used to compromise the service even after the secret is rotated. The usual safeguard is to store secrets in environment variables or a secrets manager instead of in code, and to scan repositories for leaked secrets before they reach production.

Python threads share the global interpreter lock, so CPU-bound work runs on one thread at a time unless the GIL is released. Multiprocessing spawns separate processes, each with its own interpreter and memory, and can use multiple cores. The GIL is the reason, not a bug: it prevents CPython from running many threads on CPU work in parallel. Multiprocessing trades memory and interprocess communication overhead for parallelism, and it is not automatically better for every workload.

Un load balancer distribuisce le richieste in ingresso tra più istanze di servizio per evitare che una sola sia sovraccarica. Può scegliere il prossimo target in modo round-robin, in base al carico corrente o in base al risultato di una health check, e può anche fare il primo livello di protezione contro gli attacchi DDoS. Il punto da non confondere è che il load balancer non elabora la richiesta: la spedisce e attende la risposta, che poi restituisce al cliente.
